children: Kenneth W. Lowe, a Director, reported a sale of Series A common stock on September 10, 2026. The reporting form states a weighted average selling price of $28.23 per share for multiple transactions with prices ranging from $28.13 to $28.34. The total sale amount reported was $5,646,000 for 200,000 shares disposed. Following the reported transaction, Lowe directly owns 590,108 shares and indirectly owns 793 shares held by The Lowe Family Trust.
